paragraphs: A small React component that gives people a clear route from a BOLT11 invoice to a compatible payment provider.
It offers a searchable, country-aware directory of wallets, payment apps, exchanges, and any independently verified swap routes. It is deliberately not a wallet connector or payment processor.
